name: channel-null
description: The teaching channel: accepts every outbound message while connected and delivers none of them. Inspect what was sent via the in-memory record or an optional JSONL outbox. Fork it to start a real transport.

x-meta.label: Messages to remember
x-meta.help: How many accepted messages the in-memory record keeps. Oldest are dropped first.

x-meta.label: Outbox file
x-meta.help: When set, every accepted message is appended to this file as JSONL. Leave empty to keep the record in memory only.
